lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in a grid-like formation posterior to the gill slits, primarily organized into horizontal rows following the carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal rows of circular blobs, creating distinct anchor nodes across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A dominant horizontal linear feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, exhibiting a sharp light-to-shadow vertical gradient defining a longitudinal ridge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent horizontal linear mark or indentation is visible on the mid-lateral flank, posterior to the pectoral fin, characterized by a disruption in the local spot-and-stripe pattern.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high-contrast pattern of luminance blobs on its dorsal surface and a slightly irregular posterior margin.
